item.title: [DIS] CrowdCell: From Testnet Demo to a Crowdfunding Product on CKB | CrowdCell：把 CKB 测试网上的免信任众筹做成产品 (2 posts)
item.description: Great to see CrowdCell progressing from a testnet demo toward a practical crowdfunding product on CKB! The smaller $5,000 scope makes sense, and I particularly like the focus on trustless settlement, keeper incentives, and creator tooling. I’d love to see more testing of independent keeper settlement, especially under concurrent transactions and failure scenarios. Overall, a promising direction for the CKB ecosystem. Looking forward to the next milestones! Thanks Dang. Agree on the keeper testing. Once there’s a tip in M4, several keepers racing for the same pledges is the normal case. item.title: Waymark — Recovering useful wallet state without starting from zero (1 posts)
item.description: Waymark Lite is now in Pocket Node’s main branch on both Android and iOS. When I first tested Waymark on Pocket, the idea was simple: after restoring from a seed phrase, can the wallet avoid rebuilding everything from zero? @Jnr6 took the Lite path from that work and built it into Pocket as a restore-hint flow. The Android side landed in #561, the iOS side followed in #566, and #559 is now complete. Really nice seeing the experiment turn into something concrete in the wallet this quickly. The Full recovery direction is still open in #560, so there’s still more to understand around what is worth carrying forward beyond Lite.
